workspaces.description: The public API of [Joe's Blue Archive Tools](https://ba.joexyz.online): Blue Archive game data, content that players share, and your own data on the site.
workspaces.name: Joe's Blue Archive Tools API

folders.description:
Static Blue Archive game data. No authentication is required, and
responses are cached for up to an hour.
folders.name: Game data
Shared content

folders.description:
Tactical Challenge statistics aggregated from every user's recorded
matches (only matches marked `includeInStatistics`). No authentication is
required. `season` is the season number (1–11).
folders.name: PVP statistics

folders.description:
Your own data on Joe's Blue Archive Tools. Every request needs an API key:
create one under **Manage account → API keys** in the user menu on
the site, and send it as `Authorization: Bearer <key>`.

Requests act as the key's owner and see only that user's data.
folders.name: Your data

folders.description:
Formations from the Formation Display tool.

- `type`: `normal`, `finalRestrictionRelease` or `tacticalRelay`.
- `strikers` / `specials`: slots in order; an empty object is an empty
  slot. Each slot takes `studentId`, `starter`, `starterOrder`,
  `starLevel` (1–5), `ueLevel` (1–4), `borrowed` and `level`.
- `rows`: optional extra rows for multi-team modes, each with `strikers`,
  `specials`, optional `tcs` and an optional `label`.
- `name` is 1–100 characters.
folders.name: Formations

folders.description:
Timelines from the Timeline Visualizer. `items` is a list of:

- `{ "type": "student", "studentId", "trigger"?, "targetId"?, "extraTargetIds"?, "copy"?, "variantId"?, "notes"?, "highlightColor"? }`
- `{ "type": "separator", "orientation": "horizontal" | "vertical", "size"? }`
- `{ "type": "text", "text" }`

`visibility` is `private` (default) or `public`. Public timelines can be
read by anyone through **Shared content**.
folders.name: Timelines

folders.description:
Rosters of your in-game accounts. A roster is created without students;
send the full `students` list with PATCH.

- `gameServer`: `JP`, `KR`, `TW`, `NA`, `Asia`, `EU` or `CN`.
- `friendCode`: exactly 8 uppercase letters, unique per server.
- Each student takes `studentId`, `starLevel` (1–5), `ueLevel` (1–4),
  `level`, `relationshipRank`, skill levels `ex`, `basic`, `enhanced`,
  `sub`, and optionally `equipmentSlot1`–`4`, `attackLevel`, `hpLevel`,
  `healLevel` and `featuredBorrowSlot`.
folders.name: Rosters

folders.description:
Gift inventories from the Bond EXP calculator, and the students you plan
to give gifts to (targets). `gifts` lists gift ids from **Game data → List
gifts** with how many you have.
folders.name: Gift planner

folders.description:
Your Tactical Challenge seasons, matches and presets. Every resource
belongs to a season. Times (`date`, `from`, `to`) are Unix milliseconds.
Teams are 6 slots (4 strikers, then 2 specials); each slot takes
`studentId`, `level`, `starLevel`, `ueLevel` and `damage`, all optional.
folders.name: PVP tracker

folders.description: Opponent presets group the teams and matches of one opponent.
folders.name: Opponents

folders.description: Teams you have seen opponents use, saved outside of a match.
folders.name: Enemy teams

folders.description:
Your recruitment (gacha) history per account. `permanentCharge` and
`limitedCharge` are the pity points you started tracking with.

- `gameServer`: `JP`, `KR`, `TW`, `NA`, `Asia` or `EU`. The China server isn't supported.
folders.name: Recruitment tracker

folders.description:
A session is one banner's pulls. `pickupsObtained` lists each pickup
student with the pity `charge` they came at and the pool `kind`
(`permanent` or `limited`). Statistics in `stats` are computed for you.
folders.name: Sessions

httpRequests.description:
Lists playable students in the default roster order. With `q`, every
student matching the other filters is ranked by a fuzzy match on the name
and search tags, best first, and each result gets a `matchScore`.

Filters take the values used in responses, for example `school=Abydos`
or `combatRole=Tanker`.

**Parameters**

- `q`: Fuzzy search on the name and search tags.
- `school`: `Abydos`, `Arius`, `Gehenna`, `Hyakkiyako`, `Millennium`, `RedWinter`, `Shanhaijing`, `SRT`, `Trinity`, `Valkyrie`, `Highlander`, `WildHunt`, `Odyssey`, `Tokiwadai`, `Sakugawa` or `ETC`.
- `club`: Club, e.g. `Countermeasure`.
- `attackType`: `Explosion`, `Pierce`, `Mystic`, `Sonic`, `Chemical`, `Normal` or `Mixed`, or a color: `red` (Explosion), `yellow` (Pierce), `blue` (Mystic), `purple` (Sonic) or `green` (Chemical).
- `defenseType`: `LightArmor`, `HeavyArmor`, `Unarmed`, `ElasticArmor`, `CompositeArmor`, `Normal` or `Mixed`, or a color: `red` (LightArmor), `yellow` (HeavyArmor), `blue` (Unarmed), `purple` (ElasticArmor) or `green` (CompositeArmor).
- `combatClass`: `Main` (striker) or `Support` (special).
- `combatRole`: `DamageDealer`, `Tanker`, `Healer`, `Supporter` or `Vehicle`.
- `weaponType`: `SR`, `SG`, `AR`, `MG`, `SMG`, `RG`, `HG`, `GL`, `RL`, `FT` or `MT`.
- `rarity`: Initial star rarity, 1–3.
- `limit`: Maximum number of results, 1–500. Defaults to 500.

httpRequests.description:
Gets a student's skills with per-level descriptions, plus the buffs and
debuffs (`effects`) that the descriptions refer to by id.

Descriptions are templates. For a skill level, `levelTemplates[level - 1]`
picks the template and `params[level - 1]` holds its values. The markup:

- `{p:N}`: parameter N, from `params[level - 1][N]`.
- `{e:EFFECT}…{/e}`: an effect; look it up by id in `effects`.
- `{s:STAT}…{/s}`: a stat.
- `{d:EFFECT:N}`: an effect's `suffix`, with parameter N.
- `{{`: a literal `{`.

**Parameters**

- `id` (path): The student's ID, internal numeric ID or DevName.
- `locale`: `en` (default) or `ja`. Missing texts fall back to the other language.

httpRequests.description:
Gets the Global server roadmap. Each item has a `kind` that decides its
other fields: `banner`, `raid` (Grand Assaults stay listed for two months
after they end), `event`, `story`, `frr`, `bonus`, `workLog`, `battlePass` or `etc`.

**Parameters**

- `categories`: Comma-separated kinds to return, e.g. `banner,raid`. All of them by default.
- `from`: ISO date or date-time; only items still running at or after it.
- `to`: ISO date or date-time; only items starting at or before it.
